prediction_method: Unmodified predict.run_prediction plus original grouped plotting functions. Models and stats loaded with original experiment name; short alias used only for output folders. Results subsequently relocated from temporary short aliases into the canonical experiment folders; numerical files are unchanged.
kci_method: Unmodified full all18 evaluator functions, batch_size=64, no probe sampling. The existing two-model comparison helper is called separately for each Gain method versus No-Gain, then concatenated. Full per-step diagnostic rows are not exported. Zero gains count as incorrect.
